```plato

    // The index-th corner's vertex index. Corners do not wrap: an index
    // outside [0, 3) reads the corner array, which refuses it, so an
    // off-by-one is an error instead of a silent read of C.
    At(self: TriangleFace, index: Integer): VertexIndex
        => index == 0 ? self.A : (index == 1 ? self.B : (index == 2 ? self.C : self.Vertices[index]));
```

    // The index-th corner's vertex index. Corners do not wrap: an index
    // outside [0, 4) reads the corner array, which refuses it, so an
    // off-by-one is an error instead of a silent read of D.
    At(self: QuadFace, index: Integer): VertexIndex
        => index == 0 ? self.A : (index == 1 ? self.B : (index == 2 ? self.C : (index == 3 ? self.D : self.Vertices[index])));
